posts.title: How Much Space Does a Civilization Need?
posts.description: In 2095 the human race could travel through space, but Earth was still its only home. There were stations on the Moon, expeditions to the planets, and machines farther out. But there was no place beyond Earth from which civilization could begin again if Earth were lost. That year an alien vessel was approaching the Solar System.
